title: AC1024 sample reader accepts only the qualified raw-only AcSh failure profile
status: implemented; focused AC1024 reader and raw-retention cohort passed
scope: Make the sample-reader expectation match the existing bounded raw-only recovery contract for the two AC1024 AcSh samples.
Keep zero parse failures as the default for every other sample.
Retain visible parser failures and require each permitted failure to correspond to a valid raw source frame with complete frame disposition.

guardConditions: Observed object parse failure count equals the declared sample-specific count.
Every untyped AcSh frame is AC1024, custom-class defined, object-shaped, bounded by its retained raw bytes, and one of the exact LOFT/REVOLVE class pairs.
Untyped AcSh frame count equals the visible object parse failure count.
The sample-specific LOFT/REVOLVE frame census matches its source receipt; unexpected AcSh classes or a nonzero raw-only census on other samples fails the probe.
For the raw-only exception, source frame coverage is FinalizedComplete with zero failed frame dispositions and no AcDs history capture failure.
Samples without the explicit exception continue to require zero entity and object parse failures.
implementation.unchangedBehavior: Typed parser results are not changed; the unparsed AcSh bodies remain raw-only and strict semantic/output claims remain open.

validation.focusedResult: passed: 13/13 in 3.71 seconds with exact per-sample LOFT/REVOLVE census enforcement

limits: This is a regression-test contract correction, not a change to the DWG parser or semantic support.
The body field layouts and meanings for AcDbShLoft and AcDbShRevolve remain unqualified; strict output and native 3D claims remain open.
The samples remain external/local inputs and are not committed.
fixturePolicy: No DWG or DXF fixture was added to the repository.
